newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Ciampi calls surplus data "encouraging".
newsitem.headline: Italy's Ciampi calls surplus data "encouraging".

text.p: Italian Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi on Monday hailed preliminary data that pointed to a state sector surplus in January as proof the government was on the right track.
"This data is very encouraging, it is certainly favourable although comparisons with Janaury 1996 should take into account extraordinary factors," Ciampi said in a statement.

The Treasury said earlier that Italy had a provisional state sector surplus of two trillion lire in January 1997, compared with a public sector borrowing requirement of 12.29 trillion at the end of January 1996.
"We have another 11 months ahead of us," Ciampi said. "January's result spurs us to press ahead with the line the government has taken." (( -- Rome newsroom +396 678 2501 ))
